description: vulture_creature default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (green hue clamped, skull bone, dark sockets with a green glow core, bone pendant with green socket cores) baked onto the low (improved/textures/vulture_creature_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it; three GLOW regions (eyes, eye / pendant-socket halo, pendant sockets) carry the emission (Glow -> Emission Color)

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the black feathers / bone skull as baked

eye_glow.note: the eye-socket glow core (spirit sheet eye green, top-saturation median 156,234,161); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

eye_glow_halo.note: faint halo on the dark socket faces around the core (spirit sheet palette green chip 118,190,132)

pendant_eye_glow.note: the spectre pendant's socket cores (helmet eye green, a touch dimmer)
